info.brief: Builds a world map as a graph of nodes and routes that can change at any time, draws
info.description:
Builds a world map as a graph of nodes and routes that can change at any time, draws
it for debugging, and moves game objects along it with a built-in pathfinder. Add
nodes with `map_add_node` and join them with `map_add_route`, start each game object
with `move_initialize`, then call `move_player` from its `update` and apply the
position and rotation it returns.

elements.name: ROUTETYPE
elements.brief: How `move_initialize` takes a game object through more than one destination.
elements.description:
How `move_initialize` takes a game object through more than one destination.
`ONETIME` visits them in order and stops at the last, `SHUFFLE` visits them in
random order without stopping, and `CYCLE` visits them in order and starts over
after the last. With one destination they all behave the same.
types: { ONETIME: Hash; SHUFFLE: Hash; CYCLE: Hash; }

elements.name: map_set_properties
elements.brief: Sets the module's path and movement settings, which every `move_initialize` call
elements.description:
Sets the module's path and movement settings, which every `move_initialize` call
falls back to for a setting it is not given. A `nil` keeps a setting's current
value, and each starts at the default stated on it.

parameters.name: settings_gameobject_threshold
parameters.doc:
The distance within which a game object counts
as on a route or at a point. Use a larger value for faster game objects; the
smallest useful value is `1`. Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_tightness
parameters.doc:
How tight a turn on the path is; the smallest
useful value is `2`. Defaults to `4`.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_roundness
parameters.doc:
How round a turn on the path is. `0` gives no
curves and ignores the tightness and the corner distance, and a higher value costs
more processing, most of all while nodes move. Defaults to `3`.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_max_distance_from_corner
parameters.doc:
The farthest from its corner a
turn may start. Defaults to `10`.

parameters.name: settings_allow_enter_on_route
parameters.doc:
Whether a game object may enter the map partway
along a route, rather than only at a node. Defaults to `true`.

elements.name: map_add_node
elements.brief: Adds a node at a position and returns its id. The position's `z` is ignored. A node
elements.description:
Adds a node at a position and returns its id. The position's `z` is ignored. A node
with no route takes no part in routing, so remove one that is no longer used.

parameters.name: position
parameters.doc: The node's position.

elements.name: map_update_node_position
elements.brief: Moves an existing node, and the routes attached to it with it. An unknown id fails
elements.description:
Moves an existing node, and the routes attached to it with it. An unknown id fails
an assert.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.doc: The node's id.

parameters.name: position
parameters.doc: The node's new position.

elements.name: map_remove_node
elements.brief: Removes a node and every route attached to it. An unknown id fails an assert.
elements.description: Removes a node and every route attached to it. An unknown id fails an assert.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.doc: The node's id.

elements.name: map_add_route
elements.brief: Adds a route between two nodes, both ways unless `is_one_way` is `true`. A route
elements.description:
Adds a route between two nodes, both ways unless `is_one_way` is `true`. A route
from a node to itself is ignored, and an unknown id fails an assert. A one-way route
is a little cheaper to path through when the other way is never needed.

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.doc: The node the route starts at.

parameters.name: destination_id
parameters.doc: The node the route ends at.

parameters.name: is_one_way
parameters.doc:
Whether the route runs from `source_id` to `destination_id` only.
Defaults to `false`.

elements.name: map_remove_route
elements.brief: Removes the route between two nodes, both ways unless `is_remove_one_way` is `true`.
elements.description:
Removes the route between two nodes, both ways unless `is_remove_one_way` is `true`.
An unknown id fails an assert.

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.doc: The node the route starts at.

parameters.name: destination_id
parameters.doc: The node the route ends at.

parameters.name: is_remove_one_way
parameters.doc:
Whether to remove only the way from `source_id` to
`destination_id`. Defaults to `false`.

elements.name: debug_set_properties
elements.brief: Sets the colors and the scale the `debug_draw_*` functions draw with. A `nil` keeps
elements.description:
Sets the colors and the scale the `debug_draw_*` functions draw with. A `nil` keeps
a value's current setting, and each starts at the default stated on it.

parameters.name: node_color
parameters.doc: The color of the nodes. Defaults to `vmath.vector4(1, 0, 1, 1)`.

parameters.name: two_way_route_color
parameters.doc:
The color of two-way routes. Defaults to
`vmath.vector4(0, 1, 0, 1)`.

parameters.name: one_way_route_color
parameters.doc:
The color of one-way routes. Defaults to
`vmath.vector4(0, 1, 1, 1)`.

parameters.name: draw_scale
parameters.doc: The size of the node marks. Defaults to `5`.

elements.name: debug_draw_map_nodes
elements.brief: Draws every node for one frame, by posting `draw_line` and, for the ids,
elements.description:
Draws every node for one frame, by posting `draw_line` and, for the ids,
`draw_text` to `@render:`. A node with no route is drawn as a triangle, a dead end
as a cross and an intersection as a square. Call it every frame to keep it shown.

parameters.name: is_show_ids
parameters.doc: Whether to draw each node's id beside it. Defaults to `false`.

elements.name: debug_draw_map_routes
elements.brief: Draws every route for one frame, by posting `draw_line` to `@render:`: two-way
elements.description:
Draws every route for one frame, by posting `draw_line` to `@render:`: two-way
routes in one color, and one-way routes in another with a square near the end they
run to. Call it every frame to keep it shown.

elements.name: debug_draw_player_move
elements.brief: Draws the rest of a game object's path for one frame, by posting `draw_line` to
elements.description:
Draws the rest of a game object's path for one frame, by posting `draw_line` to
`@render:`. Nothing is drawn while the game object stands still for want of a
route. Call it every frame to keep it shown.

parameters.name: movement_data
parameters.doc: The movement data from `move_initialize` or `move_player`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.doc: The color of the path.

parameters.name: is_show_intersection
parameters.doc:
Whether to mark each point on the path with a cross.
Defaults to `false`.

elements.name: move_initialize
elements.brief: Starts a game object moving from its position through a list of destination nodes,
elements.description:
Starts a game object moving from its position through a list of destination nodes,
and returns the movement data `move_player` takes. Each setting it is not given
falls back to the value `map_set_properties` set. To change the destinations, call
it again and replace the old movement data with the result.

parameters.name: source_position
parameters.doc: The game object's current position.

parameters.name: destination_list
parameters.doc:
The destination node ids, in order. With an empty list the
game object stands still and `move_player` reports no `destination_id`.

parameters.name: route_type
parameters.doc: One of `ROUTETYPE`. Defaults to `ROUTETYPE.ONETIME`.

parameters.name: initial_face_vector
parameters.doc:
The direction the game object faces at zero rotation.
Without it, `move_player` returns no rotation.

parameters.name: settings_gameobject_threshold
parameters.doc:
The distance within which the game object counts
as on a route or at a point. Defaults to the `map_set_properties` value.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_tightness
parameters.doc:
How tight a turn on the path is. Defaults to the
`map_set_properties` value.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_roundness
parameters.doc:
How round a turn on the path is, `0` for no
curves. Defaults to the `map_set_properties` value.

parameters.name: settings_path_curve_max_distance_from_corner
parameters.doc:
The farthest from its corner a
turn may start. Defaults to the `map_set_properties` value.

parameters.name: settings_allow_enter_on_route
parameters.doc:
Whether the game object may enter the map partway
along a route. Defaults to the `map_set_properties` value.

elements.name: move_player
elements.brief: Moves a game object one step along its path toward its current destination, and
elements.description:
Moves a game object one step along its path toward its current destination, and
returns the movement data and the result of the move:
`const [data, result] = defgraph.move_player(go.get_position(), speed * dt, move)`.
Keep the returned movement data in place of the one passed in. When the map has
changed since the last call, the path is found again first. `result.rotation` is
`undefined` unless `move_initialize` was given an `initial_face_vector`.

parameters.name: current_position
parameters.doc: The game object's current position.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.doc:
How far the game object moves this call, its speed already multiplied
by `dt`.

parameters.name: move_data
parameters.doc: The movement data from `move_initialize` or the last `move_player`.

properties.name: destination_list
properties.brief: The destination node ids, the same list `move_initialize` was given.
properties.description: The destination node ids, the same list `move_initialize` was given.

properties.name: destination_index
properties.brief: The 1-based index of the current destination in `destination_list`.
properties.description:
The 1-based index of the current destination in `destination_list`.
**⚠️ 1-based; passed to `defgraph` unchanged.**

properties.name: route_type
properties.brief: The `ROUTETYPE` the game object moves by.
properties.description: The `ROUTETYPE` the game object moves by.

properties.name: path_index
properties.brief: The 1-based index of the next point on the path, or `0` while the game object
properties.description:
The 1-based index of the next point on the path, or `0` while the game object
stands still because the map has no route or `destination_list` is empty.
**⚠️ 1-based; passed to `defgraph` unchanged.**

properties.name: rotation
properties.brief: The game object's next rotation around z, relative to the `initial_face_vector`
properties.description:
The game object's next rotation around z, relative to the `initial_face_vector`
passed to `move_initialize`. `undefined` when `move_initialize` was given none.

properties.name: is_reached
properties.brief: Whether the game object is at its destination. With more than one destination it
properties.description:
Whether the game object is at its destination. With more than one destination it
reads `true` on reaching each one, then `false` again while `destination_id` moves
on to the next.

properties.name: destination_id
properties.brief: The node id of the current destination.
properties.description: The node id of the current destination.
